dialog.tickSectionsHint: Tick the sections you want in the exported PDF.

includeStudentDetails.label: Include student details fields
includeStudentDetails.description: Adds a fill-in strip on page 1 — Name, Roll No., Class / Batch, Date. Turn off for a cleaner practice handout.

showTitle.label: Show assessment title
showTitle.description: Hides the large centred title (currently "{{title}}") on every page. The letterhead + variant badge remain.

showFooterDate.label: Show date in footer
showFooterDate.description: Prints the export date alongside the institute name in the page footer.

showFooterConfidential.label: Show "Confidential" in footer
showFooterConfidential.descriptionLong: Adds a Confidential label to the page footer. Useful for exams; remove for casual practice handouts.
showFooterConfidential.descriptionShort: Adds a Confidential label to the page footer.
